import sys
from collections import defaultdict, deque

def lca_binary_lifting(tree, depth, parent, n):
    max_log = n.bit_length()
    for i in range(n):
        parent[i][0] = parent[i]
    for j in range(1, max_log):
        for i in range(n):
            if parent[i][j-1] != -1:
                parent[i][j] = parent[parent[i][j-1]][j-1]

def find_lca(a, b, depth, parent):
    if depth[a] < depth[b]:
        a, b = b, a
    max_log = len(parent[0])
    diff = depth[a] - depth[b]
    for j in range(max_log):
        if diff & (1 << j):
            a = parent[a][j]
    if a == b:
        return a
    for j in range(max_log-1, -1, -1):
        if parent[a][j] != parent[b][j]:
            a = parent[a][j]
            b = parent[b][j]
    return parent[a][0]

def preprocess(tree, depth, parent, n):
    queue = deque([(0, 0)])
    while queue:
        node, d = queue.popleft()
        depth[node] = d
        for neighbor in tree[node]:
            if depth[neighbor] == -1:
                parent[neighbor][0] = node
                queue.append((neighbor, d + 1))
    lca_binary_lifting(tree, depth, parent, n)
